title: Repair raw-text HTML escaping without double-escaping inserted entities
requirements: escapeHtmlText(text) receives a JavaScript string and returns a string. Replace every original & with &, < with <, > with >, double quote with ", and single quote with '. Use exactly these entity spellings.

Do not escape characters introduced by replacement. Treat preexisting entity-like input as raw text: its original ampersands must be escaped. Preserve every other character and its order, including Unicode and whitespace. Empty strings are valid.
Change only lib/subject.mjs. Owner tests and dependencies are fixed. No HTML parsing, entity decoding, normalization, or external packages are needed.
